candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis requires three components: SLE, IgA Nephropathy (confirmed by IgA 3+ mesangial deposition on IF and mesangial electron-dense deposits on EM), and Acute Progressive Glomerulonephritis (confirmed by large number of cellular crescents on LM and rapidly progressive clinical course with anuria). C001 correctly identifies SLE with renal involvement but does not specify the IgA nephropathy subtype or the crescentic/APGN component, both of which are explicitly supported by biopsy findings and clinical presentation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures SLE with renal involvement but omits the specific renal pathology subtypes: IgA Nephropathy and Acute Progressive Glomerulonephritis (crescentic pattern)

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis with three required components; biopsy findings clearly support all three
Unusual combination: IgA nephropathy with crescents in the setting of SLE (ANA+, anti-Sm+, low complement) — may represent lupus nephritis with IgA-dominant pattern or true overlap
